variants.prompt:
Create ONE finished, exceptional-quality transparent full-body 2D EVO game fish asset by COMBINING the TWO supplied reference artworks into one coherent animal.

REFERENCE 1 is the exact DOMINANT STAGE-3 form and is the main canvas/identity anchor. Preserve its defining maximum-strength feature at FULL original size and complexity. Do not weaken or average away this feature.
REFERENCE 2 provides ONLY the stated SECONDARY STAGE-1 trait. Incorporate the recognisable FIRST-TIER version of that one feature, with its characteristic shape and visible extent, into reference 1. Both traits must be immediately apparent when comparing the result to reference 1 alone. Do not copy any unrelated reference-2 body, mouth, head or fin characteristics. Do not upgrade both traits to stage 3, and do not introduce an upgrade to the third trait.

Hand-painted game style must precisely match both source illustrations: cool slate-blue silver rounded body, pale ivory-grey fin membranes, dark navy organic ink outline, quiet broad painterly light and shadow masses, restrained handmade texture, large round cream-and-black eye with same highlight, silver belly, integrated dark gill fold. Preserve the same fish species identity, overall body proportions, fin-root anatomy and top-left lighting. Natural coherent anatomy, clean deliberate negative spaces, confident shapes legible at 90px. No generic fantasy monster, no new colour scheme, no ornamental spikes. Any ivory skull plates have sculpted broad organic bone fields and graceful seams; fins are pale membranes with a few darker rays; teeth are natural ivory integrated with the mouth.

Strict orthographic SIDE VIEW, horizontal and facing RIGHT, entire fish with tail at LEFT, neutral swimming posture with calm alert eye; not attacking. Mouth follows the dominant/secondary instructions below. ONE fish only, no split comparison, no detached components, no extra eyes. Truly transparent alpha background, no coloured backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into image, no water, particles, outside shadow, halo, text, numbers, watermark or frame. Same landscape canvas ideally 1675 x 939. Include every tail lobe, fin tip and snout with empty margin on all four sides; reframe uniformly if needed but NEVER clip or squeeze the body. Production-quality unanimated master painting.

EXACT COMBINATION: BITE 3 + FINS 1 + SKULL 0. Keep the HUGE interlocking front fangs, massive deep blue-grey lower jaw, broad snout and long gape of reference 1 unchanged in strength and size. Smooth forehead without any skull plates. Replace reference 1's ordinary compact fins with the visible FIRST-TIER fins from reference 2: broad pointed pectoral steering paddle with larger pale membrane area, stronger ventral fin, wider swept-back SINGLE dorsal fin, and notably taller more deeply V-forked tail with two tapered pale lobes. These fins must clearly look like the first upgraded fin form, not the base small fins; but no extra dorsal finlets, no second dorsal, no giant terminal crescent tail. A fierce maximum bite coexisting with an unmistakable modest fin upgrade.
